mode_partition_normalisation.rule: summary.rs mode_fractions: positive branching ratios normalised to unit sum; a sum short of one by more than 1e-5 books the shortfall to `other`; no modes books everything to `other`

c_trace_vs_coupled.note: results/g7_mode_selection.json records a trace/coupled heat difference of 2.5e-4 on this spec (its pass criterion is the floor rule), so the 1e-8 text of P5 G7 is not what that control enforces. Both measures are reported per step.
c_trace_vs_coupled.rule: A total passes if it agrees to 1e-8 relative, OR differs by no more than the coupled floor (atoms/g) times the per-atom coefficient summed over the states that carry at least 1 % of that total in the trace run. Separately, every nuclide with at least 1 % of the trace activity must have |N_coupled - N_trace| <= the coupled floor (the g7_mode_selection.py rule).
tolerance_source: protocols/ACTINV-P5_PROTOCOL.md G7: trace and coupled agree to 1e-8 on the FNS Fe spec (relative 1e-08, applied here to every total)

protocols/ACTINV-P9_PROTOCOL.md G3, controls/g3_p9_coupled_auto.py and controls/g7_mode_selection.py: where the modes differ they agree within the coupled CRAM floor (numerical_floor_atoms_per_g); g7_mode_selection.py applies it, per nuclide, to the nuclides carrying at least 1 % of the activity

intervals.note: no ACTINV step at this time

G5.note: Different libraries (TENDL-2017 vs TENDL-2025): differences are expected. No pass threshold.
G5.time_mapping: FISPACT irradiation interval: ACTINV t_s = 'TIME IS' seconds; cooling interval: ACTINV t_s = end of the last irradiating step (300 s) + the running sum of the 'COOLING TIME IS' seconds
